paper.title: UAV-VLRR: Vision-Language Informed NMPC for Rapid Response in UAV Search and Rescue
paper.central_claim: UAV-VLRR 把 ChatGPT-4o + Molmo-7B 的图文场景解读（目标点/障碍点）与带障碍惩罚的点到点 NMPC 级联，使无人机搜救任务完成更快：两场景平均比现成自动驾驶仪快 33.75%、比人类飞手快 54.6%。
paper.claim_scope: 作者结论级措辞为 'outperforms other traditional approaches in the field of drone search and rescue'；实验仅为同一室内竞技场的 2 个静态场景、每方法每场景 1 次飞行。

evidence.quote: our approach was faster on an average by 33.75% when compared with an off-the-shelf autopilot and 54.6% when compared with a human pilot
evidence.support_explanation: 作者中心主张及数字。

evidence.quote: ChatGPT-4o serves as the LLM agent, responsible for extracting goal objects
evidence.support_explanation: LLM 只做目标/障碍抽取。

evidence.quote: is utilized as the VLM agent for image processing and goal object identification
evidence.support_explanation: Molmo-7B 4bit 做像素定位。

evidence.quote: The horizontal and vertical real-world dimensions in meters are first calculated from the diagonal FoV and camera height
evidence.support_explanation: 像素到世界坐标的换算仅依赖相机高度与 FoV（隐含平地/俯视假设）。

evidence.quote: the objective function has a penalty term associated with the obstacle points received from the multimodal system
evidence.support_explanation: 障碍点以惩罚项进入 NMPC；惩罚项具体形式未给出。

evidence.quote: This approach enables the drone to fly properly despite the model mismatches since now it does not have strict constraints of tracking a given trajectory.
evidence.support_explanation: 点到点 NMPC 的设计理由（模型失配、机载算力）。

evidence.quote: Exp 2: The drone flies to the target points using an off-the-shelf autopilot.
evidence.support_explanation: 自动驾驶基线未命名、未说明其目标点是否与 Exp1 完全相同。

evidence.quote: A human drone pilot is shown the picture and then flies around the target points while having access to a belly-mounted camera on the drone.
evidence.support_explanation: 人类飞手基线的信息与接口条件。

evidence.quote: For the UAV-VLRR framework, the timing started as soon as the code was launched, while for the human pilot, the timing started as soon as the image was shown.
evidence.support_explanation: 计时起点不对称：系统含推理延迟，人类含读图时间；与自动驾驶基线计时起点未说明。

evidence.quote: Time Taken for Scene 1 (s) 28 40 57 Time Taken for Scene 2 (s) 30 48 72
evidence.support_explanation: 每场景每方法仅一个耗时数字，无重复。

evidence.quote: an identification was considered accurate if the detected point was within a 25 cm radius of the actual object

evidence.quote: during manual flights, the human pilot was more prone to crashing into the obstacles

evidence.quote: traditional UAV-based SAR relies heavily on manual flight control or waypoint setting

evidence.quote: unlike most of the work mentioned in the literature, which focus on first an external trajectory generation module and then a trajectory following module

evidence.quote: The multimodal system ran on a remote server with an RTX 4090 GPU (24GB VRAM)

evidence.quote: the image was not captured from a very high altitude, which may have resulted in some distortion or skewing

evidence.quote: We demonstrate that our framework outperforms other traditional approaches in the field of drone search and rescue
evidence.support_explanation: 结论级主张范围远超两个室内场景。

evidence.quote: the integration of dynamic environmental factors, such as moving obstacles

signatures.object: 图文场景解读到 NMPC 目标/障碍点的级联管线（LLM 抽取 + VLM 定位 + FoV 几何换算）
signatures.information: 单张 2D 航拍图 + 自然语言指令 + 相机高度/FoV；无深度；无任务执行反馈回流至 LLM/VLM
signatures.operation: GPT-4o 抽取 target/obstacle 对象 → Molmo-7B 输出像素坐标 → 按相机高度与 FoV 换算为世界坐标
signatures.output: 目标点与障碍点的世界坐标列表，交 NMPC
signatures.conditions: 俯视/平地近似；相机高度已知；静态障碍
signatures.feedback: 无（一次性开环抽取；执行期不回读图像）
signatures.claimed_effect: 更快完成任务（时间 28/30 s vs 自动驾驶 40/48 s）
signatures.failure_boundary: 作者仅提及图像畸变带来的定位误差；动态障碍未处理

signatures.object: 点到点 NMPC 控制器（13 状态四旋翼动力学，RK4 + 多重射击，障碍惩罚项）
signatures.information: 目标点、障碍点、本机状态；不需要外部轨迹生成
signatures.operation: 每个控制周期在线求解最小化 到目标距离 + 控制代价 + 障碍惩罚 的 NMPC（CasADi）
signatures.output: 电机推力指令序列的第一步
signatures.conditions: 最小动力学模型（无气动补偿）；机载 OrangePi；障碍惩罚形式及安全半径参数未给出
signatures.feedback: 闭环状态反馈（MPC 标准）
signatures.claimed_effect: 不要求跟踪给定轨迹因而对模型失配更宽容，且可机载运行
signatures.failure_boundary: 未报告求解频率、碰撞次数、对失配的鲁棒性测试
